title: How big is it?
description:
Use `sizeof` to print how many bytes each of these types takes, one number per line, in this order: `char`, `int`, `double`, `long long`.

On this computer the answer is:

```
1
4
8
8
```

Do not type the numbers yourself: ask the compiler with `sizeof(type)`.
hints: `sizeof(int)` is an expression that gives a number, so you can print it directly: `std::cout << sizeof(int) << '\n';`
